title: I’ve been experimenting with custom AI workflows to generate fast 2D RPG assets. Do these look cohesive enough for a modern indie game?
author: MaxAIArt
selftext:
Hey everyone. I know inventory art is a massive bottleneck for solo devs. Recently, I've been building custom ControlNet workflows to try and engineer specific RPG props that actually match each other in style, rather than just getting that random 'AI mush' look.

My goal is to see if this workflow is actually viable for indie devs who need placeholder or final 2D assets quickly so they can focus on coding.

I’d love some brutal feedback from actual developers: Are these too stylized? Do they look like they belong in the same game universe? Let me know what you think!
